note: `affected_episodes` is transitive reverse reachability. The trigger is filed on `prg-omfv`, and every main-chain episode references the programme through `DecisionEpisode.program`, so the raw set is the whole programme, not only the three sections GAO graded. The three sections are the episodes whose own `claims` list holds one of the claims the trigger names; `gradedSections` is that subset, and it is ours, not the kernel's.
